jobs.title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities.  This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company.

As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience.

About the Role

You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash's data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.

As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company's exponential growth.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company
  • Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting
  • Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes.
  • Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources.
  • Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality.
  • Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines.
  • Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners.
  • Participate in defining the Company's data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems.
  • Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role.
  • Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows.
  • Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools.
  • You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines.
  • Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.
  • You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • You're an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates.
  • Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Senior Process Engieer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Music Content and Catalogue
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own what learners actually play. Our catalogue is the heart of the Skoove experience, and it is also our largest content cost and our most constrained resource. Every song in the app exists because someone negotiated the right to put it there, modelled what it would cost, and judged what it would do for the learner.


That is your job. You own the songs in our piano learning apps end to end: which music we license, what it costs, what each licence permits, and what it does for our learners. Our didactics lead owns the teaching content, and the two of you decide together which songs carry the didactics.


You work alongside a didactics lead and a content producer, and you are the voice of content in our product owner round. You bring the commercial and rights lens. They bring pedagogy and production.


This is not an internally facing product role. You will sit across the table from music publishers and labels, model the deals, and understand what each licence allows in the app. Our CEO leads negotiations with you at the start and an external licensing advisor supports the specialist work. You grow into owning it.


And you care about the music itself. Getting the songs people actually want to play into a learning app, at a cost that works, is one of the most satisfying puzzles in this company.


You have a real passion for AI tools: prototyping, analysis, modelling, experimentation. You bring new thinking on AI-first product work and model that mindset for others.


Your job

  • Own the song catalogue for the Skoove apps: what we add, what we retire, and why. You have a point of view on which music learners want to play, and the evidence to back it. 

  • Co-own the song selection inside the didactics together with our didactics lead. Their pedagogy, your rights and catalogue view.

  • Own the commercial modelling of content: licence cost per subscriber and per song, revenue share, catalogue coverage against learner value, and the conversion effect of licensed content. 

  • Own the rights picture: which repertoire we hold, under what terms and territories, and what each licence permits in the product. Keep the clearance gate current so no song ships uncleared.

  • Represent us with publishers and labels. Prepare the position, evaluate term sheets, identify the assumptions worth challenging, and document the relationship. Supported by the CEO and an external advisor, with the aim of taking full ownership.

  • Be accountable for contractual reporting to partners: usage reports in the agreed format by the contract deadline, payments, audits and disputes. Colleagues in Commercial and Finance build and contribute to those reports. You own that they land on time.

  • Monitor usage against plan: usage share per publisher, dilution against targets, and act when the numbers move. Translate licensing constraints and opportunities into product decisions, and carry product's catalogue requests back into licensing.

  • Own the content unit's backlog and work closely with the team's engineer to turn priorities into progress. Prototype with AI coding tools where you can rather than waiting for a sprint, and contribute to the product owner round, sharing context and supporting the other product owners when useful.


Where is the role heading:

You start with the catalogue and the licensing relationships we have. Over the first year you take full ownership of negotiations as the CEO steps back, and you shape how our content strategy scales across further products and partner apps. The right person wants to own a domain, not administer one.


Your profile

Must have:


  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, with at least 2 years in a role with clear ownership and responsibility. Product management experience is preferred, but we also welcome backgrounds in music licensing, rights, catalogue, partnerships or commercial roles.

  • A working understanding of the music licensing world. You know what a publisher, a PRO and a mechanical licence are, you have seen how rights affect a product, and you are curious about the rest. We will teach you the depth.

  • You play piano, or you have learned it far enough to remember exactly what was hard. You understand the learner's journey from the inside: what motivates beginners, what makes them quit, what keeps them coming back.

  • Strong partner and stakeholder management skills. You are comfortable working directly with external partners and taking part in negotiations. You are also highly reliable when it comes to contractual obligations and recurring deadlines — when something needs to land on time, you make sure it does.

  • Strong analytical and commercial skills. You are comfortable with cohort data, experimentation and commercial modelling. You can build the case for an investment in a spreadsheet, understand what the data is telling you and defend the assumptions behind it.

  • Product management skills. You are comfortable with prioritisation, balancing user and business needs, and turning them into clear decisions and outcomes. You are outcome-oriented and entrepreneurial: you take ownership of results, not tasks.

  • AI fluency and curiosity. You are confident in using AI/LLM tools to support data analysis, modelling, reporting, presentations and day-to-day product work, with a strong willingness to experiment and rapidly develop new AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.


Strong plus:


  • Hands-on experience in music rights, publishing, licensing, royalties or catalogue work.

  • Content or catalogue product experience at a streaming, media, audiobook or games company.

  • Strong product discovery skills. You go from user problem to hypothesis to test to decision, using qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • Experience negotiating with suppliers or rights holders.

  • Financial modelling depth.

  • German language skills in addition to English.

  • Music tech, e-learning, gaming or consumer entertainment background.


What's in it for you?

Profitable, growing music-tech company at a pivotal moment. Lean hierarchies, fast decisions. International team in Berlin-Friedrichshain. EUR 2,500 learning budget. Up to 60% remote. Yearly offsites. 28 vacation days.


Eligibilty

  • Cover letter and resume

  • European work permit

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate

  • 30 to 40 hours per week, your preference

  • Bonus: Examples of product work. Products you built, decisions you made, results you drove


Job Start

mid-November 2026

jobs.description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

 

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation.

 
 

The role

You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you.

Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you.

 

What you'll do

 

Own French payroll

  • Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks

  • Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations)

  • Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium

  • Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis

  • Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise

  • Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships

  • Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes

 

Run the employee lifecycle

  • Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data

  • Keep Workday data accurate and compliant

  • Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects

  • You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP.

 

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it

  • Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar)

  • Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased

  • A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better

  • Comfort working in English in a multicultural team

  • Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope

 

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

 

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

 

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

jobs.title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region
  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
  • Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences
  • Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon

  • We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages.
  • We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world.
  • Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer!

Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

 

Vos missions : 

 

Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns mit ihrer fachlichen Expertise unterstützen. Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen?

Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d), die unser Team in Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen)

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten)

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen

  • Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools)

  • Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden

  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem

  • DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern

Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung)

  • System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte)

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

  • Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen

  • Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
    Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar. 

  • Attraktive Vergütung:
    Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen.

  • Professionelle Mandate:
    Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
    Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Hochmodernes Büro:
    Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

  • Digitale Arbeitswelt:
    Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung.

  • Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld

jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.

Hast du schon mal eine Person eingestellt und gewusst: Diese eine Entscheidung verändert die ganze Firma?

Hast du schon mal erlebt, wie eine einzige falsche Besetzung ein kleines Team um Monate zurückwirft?

Und hast du dir schon mal gewünscht, nicht die 30. Rolle des Jahres abzuarbeiten, sondern bei jeder Einstellung wirklich mitzugestalten, wohin ein Unternehmen wächst?

Bei FINE DINE ist jede Einstellung genau das: ein Hebel. Wir sind heute 9 Leute und wachsen auf 15 bis 20. Bis 2030 wollen wir die FINE DINE Box in mehr als 100 Städte in Europa bringen.   • Recruiting Ownership: Du verantwortest das Recruiting für ca. 5 Rollen pro Jahr, strategisch und operativ. Von der Bedarfsklärung mit uns Foundern über Stellenanzeigen und strukturierte Interviews bis zum Angebot.

  • Datenkompetenz & Kommunikation : Du steuerst nach Zahlen, nicht nach Bauchgefühl, und hast Zielwerte wie Time-to-Hire im Kopf.
  • Stressresistenz: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn mehrere Prozesse und Projekte parallel laufen und ein Wunschkandidat kurzfristig absagt.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Benefits

  • Serve the company's core data consumers. Enable Account Management to understand adoption within specific accounts, help Revenue and Finance understand where the company makes money, and provide leadership with dependable company-level reporting.

  • Create self-service foundations. Build clear marts, documentation, and dashboards that let teams answer recurring questions without requiring a custom analysis each time.

 

What makes this role different

This is neither a dashboard-only analytics role nor an infrastructure-only data engineering role. You will own the complete system, from how product data is generated to how a metric is interpreted in a product or business decision.

The hardest part is not writing SQL or operating ClickHouse. It is developing enough product and business context to model ambiguous data correctly while building technical systems that remain dependable as Langdock changes quickly.

Because this is our first dedicated data hire, you will establish the standards for data modeling, quality, ownership, observability, and collaboration across Product Development.

 

What success could look like

Within your first year:

  • Product squads can understand adoption and behavior without questioning whether the underlying data is correct.

  • Important pipelines and models have explicit owners, tests, freshness expectations, monitoring, and recovery procedures.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.

  • Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria.

  • Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care.

  • Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance.

  • Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations.

  • Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination.

     

WHO YOU ARE

  • Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment.

  • Practical electrical measurement skills.

  • The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure.

  • Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results.

  • A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability.

  • The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop.

  • Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings.

Nice to have

  • Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements.

  • High-current DC testing or quench detection.

  • Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems.

jobs.title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
jobs.description:
About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

About this position:

You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

Requirements

What you'll do:

As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

  • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
  • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
  • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
  • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
  • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
  • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
  • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
-

How you'll grow:

During your first 3–6 months 
Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

Within 1 year

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. jobs.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus

  • Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and/or native SDKs like OpenAI/Anthropic

  • Observability and evaluation for LLM/agent workflows

  • Vector search, scoring, prompting, LLM orchestration

  • Hybrid recommender systems, causal inference, probabilistic models

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • TypeScript

  • Engineering: Docker, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector DBs, PostHog

  • CI/CD

Why Join Us

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

Deine Mission

Als Sales Operations Manager - Memory Solutions (MEM) stellst du sicher, dass unser zukünftiges Vertriebsmodell wirksam, transparent und skalierbar funktioniert. Du übersetzt das definierte strategische Zielbild in ein klares operatives Sales-Vorgehensmodell.   • Cross-functional Coordination: Sicherstellung effizienter Abläufe und klarer Entscheidungswege zwischen Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Finance und Supply Chain

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung. Alternativ überzeugst du durch eine gleichwertige Kombination aus Berufserfahrung und fachlicher Weiterbildung

jobs.title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

About You

  • 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript.

  • Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python.

  • Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases.

  • Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause.

  • Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact.

  • Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients.

  • Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight.

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is identical within professional levels, regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

If you're a driven sales professional with deep roots in the asset management sector and a passion for connecting clients to the data solutions they depend on, this is a rare opportunity to own and shape a high-growth territory across DACH and Central Europe.

As Senior Business Development Manager, you'll take the lead on one of FE fundinfo's most strategically important regions, bringing our Dissemination & Distribution solutions to asset managers, fund promoters, platforms and data vendors across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. This is a role where your market knowledge, client relationships and commercial instincts will directly influence product direction, go-to-market strategy, and the growth of a business that sits at the heart of the fund distribution ecosystem. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across sales, product and client success, with the backing of a dedicated BDR team and marketing function.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior Business Development Manager will include:

  • Owning and executing the sales strategy for our Dissemination and Distribution solutions across asset managers and fund promoters in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe.
  • Driving pipeline growth and bookings through programmatic execution of the DACH and Central Europe go-to-market plan, including cross-sell and new name sales plays.
  • Positioning FE fundinfo's Dissemination solutions to help clients distribute fund data, factsheets and regulatory documents to platforms, distributors and data vendors.
  • Partnering with marketing and a dedicated BDR team to drive demand, and representing FE fundinfo at industry events across the DACH and Central European markets.
  • Collaborating with Client Success Managers to deliver a seamless post-sales experience and with product teams to bring client insight into the roadmap.
  • Supporting the development of junior sales team members by sharing best practices and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Senior Business Development Manager:

  • You have a proven track record in SaaS technology or data sales, with direct experience selling into the asset management sector.
  • You have consistently performed in a quota-bearing sales environment, managing pipelines and delivering against revenue targets.
  • You are fluent in English to at least C1 level, with strong written and verbal communication and executive presence.
  • You are proficient in applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to qualify and close complex, high-value opportunities.
  • You are willing to travel regularly across the DACH and Central European territory to build and maintain senior client relationships.

FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!

At FE fundinfo, we believe that great work happens when people are trusted, supported and given the space to grow. You'll join a team of commercially minded, intellectually curious professionals who collaborate across borders and disciplines. We offer flexible and hybrid working arrangements, a strong culture of learning and development, and regular team events that bring people together — whether you're based in Frankfurt or Zurich.

Apply now and we'll aim to get back to you with feedback within 5 working days.

jobs.title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 530 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.
  • Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten.
  • Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.
  • Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken.
  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).
  • Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist.
  • Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde.
  • Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten.
  • Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.
  • Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit.
  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Wachstum und Karrierechancen bei guter Leistung, unterstützt durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen.
  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeiten in einem ambitionierten Team mit regelmäßigem Austausch und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.
  • Körperliches Wohlbefinden: Eine subventionierte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellpass, die Deine körperliche Gesundheit unterstützt.


Gleiche Chancen

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.


Kontakt

Wenn Du bereit bist, die digitale Zukunft der Augenheilkunde mitzugestalten, möchten wir von Dir hören! Bewirb Dich jetzt, um unserem dynamischen Team beizutreten und einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf das Leben der Menschen zu haben. jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

  • Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

  • Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

  • Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

  • Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

  • Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

  • Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

  • Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

  • 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

  • Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

  • Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

  1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

  2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

  3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

  4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Ready for a Work-Life Upgrade under the Mediterranean Sun?

Imagine swapping cold commutes and grey skies for morning frappés, after-work dips in the Aegean, and weekends exploring island hideaways or ancient historic streets. If you speak German and have been dreaming of an exciting international fresh start, this is your sign!

At Next Job Abroad, we don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. We treat your job search like a personalized matching service. As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will be the voice and face of global brands for German-speaking customers across Europe:

  • Be the Problem Solver: Assist customers via phone, live chat, and/or email with inquiries regarding products, order tracking, bookings, or account support.
  • Deliver Top-Class Service: Turn tricky situations into positive customer moments through clear, empathetic, and friendly communication.

  • Fluency in German: Native or fluent (C1/C2 level) in both written and spoken communication.
  • Good English Knowledge: (B2 level or higher) to navigate company systems and communicate with international team members.
  • Work Eligibility: EU Passport or a valid legal work permit for Greece.
  • Age Requirement: At least 18 years old.
  • Digital Literacy: Comfortable navigating computers, multi-screen environments, and basic software applications.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication skills, active listening, empathy, and a positive problem-solving mindset.
  • Relocation Readiness: Willingness and motivation to relocate to Greece in the coming weeks.

Benefits

  • 14 Salaries per Year: In Greece, you receive extra salary bonuses for Easter, Summer, and Christmas!
  • Monthly Performance Bonuses: Extra financial rewards based on your achievements and team KPIs.
  • Full Relocation Support:
    • Flight tickets booked to Greece
    • Complimentary hotel or apartment stay upon arrival
    • Dedicated assistance with local paperwork (AFM tax number, social security, bank accounts)
    • Real estate guidance to help you find your permanent apartment in Athens
  • Paid Professional Training: Comprehensive onboarding program to get you fully confident before taking your first customer inquiry.
  • Career Progression: Clear growth paths into Quality Assurance, Team Leadership, Training, or Operations within major global companies.
  • Mediterranean Lifestyle: Over 300 days of sunshine a year, vibrant city life, world-famous cuisine, and incredible beaches right on your doorstep.

A Recruitment Process Built Around Your Profile

We know moving to another country is a big decision, so we make the journey smooth and completely transparent:

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Command Centre (Frontend & UI/UX)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

What You'll Work On

  • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

  • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

  • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

  • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

  • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

  • Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

Who We're Looking For

A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure.

Your Background

  • 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

  • Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

  • UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests.

  • Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC).

  • Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts.

Nice to Have

  • Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces.

  • Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar).

  • Building a design system from scratch.

  • Defence or regulated customers.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

jobs.description:
